title: Hausdorff compactness and regularity for classes of open sets under geometric constraints
summary: This article introduces innovative classes of open sets in \(\mathbb{R}^{N}\), where \(N=2, 3\), characterized by a geometric property associated with the inward normal. The focus lies on proving compactness results for the Hausdorff topology within these classes. Furthermore, the paper establishes the equivalence of convergences, encompassing Hausdorff, compact, and characteristic functions, for select classes.
